pr_title: Adopt Hue integration to latest changes in Hue firmware
pr_body:
## Breaking change
- For Illuminance sensors, the "light_level_valid" attribute has been removed.
- For motion sensors, the "motion_valid" attribute has been removed.

## Proposed change
Recent Hue bridge firmware updates brought a few schema changes as well as new device types.
The aiohue library has been adjusted to handle this in a backwards compatible way and this PR brings the changes, as well as the new sensor devices, to the Hue integration within HA.

- Bump aiohue library to version 4.7.0 - [release notes](https://github.com/home-assistant-libs/aiohue/releases/tag/4.7.0)
- Some minor changes to the schema and tests to adopt for the changes in aiohue 4.7.0
- Add new contact/tamper/camera_motion sensor types to be discovered, including tests
